news.text: 👋✅ "For #Miretti, we are at the closing stage between #Juventus and #Besiktas. It was a day of contacts, with the player's openness and constant calls from #Italiano. Based on a verbal agreement, we are now at the exchange of documents. The plan is to have him travel as early as today, or possibly Thursday depending on bureaucratic timelines. The deal is a loan with an option to buy, though with Turkish clubs it is right to remain prudent until the documents are exchanged."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

#AtleticoMadrid moving towards to keep Alexander #Sørloth; because Atleti don’t want to risk to lose two strikers. In fact Julian #Alvarez’s future at Atletico is still in doubt: Arana pushing to leave. #transfers[Nico Schira]
#Cabal FOR NOW is rejecting proposals, the latest from #Bologna. #Juventus is pushing him toward the exit and will persist.[Alfredo Pedullà]

🤔⁉️ "There are no updates for #Sørloth. #AtléticoMadrid first wants to understand what will happen with Julian #Alvarez: focus is on this, the Norwegian is not moving for now. Nico #González can still be part of the deal, but today zero steps forward. Meanwhile, #David must leave, he has some interest, including from #CrystalPalace, but #Juventus will let him go only when they have a replacement of equal caliber."[Di Marzio - Sky Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

👀 Franck #Kessié is waiting to find out his future.#Juventus continues to look for a new midfielder and the name is precisely that of the Ivorian, who has given priority to the bianconeri and so far has not wanted to look deeper into other offers.#Juve is pushing forward, but they must complete exits in the midfield before being able to proceed and close the deal.The sale of Fabio #Miretti, on the verge of being closed with #Beşiktaş, might not be enough to free up space.It is, therefore, also a matter of timing, which could eventually pay in favor of other interested clubs.Among the clubs that have entered the race for #Kessié, therefore, is also #Roma.The giallorossi, in fact, are the late

#Besiktas have offered a loan with the option to buy to #Juventus to sign Fabio #Miretti, who has given his availability for 4-years contract. #Juve would prefer an obligation to buy upon reaching certain conditions, but expected tomorrow direct talks to close the deal[Nico Schira]

🚨⚪️⚫️ Besiktas reach verbal agreement to sign Fabio Miretti from Juventus, here we go!Italian midfielder to join on paid loan with buy option clause to be over €10m.Paperwork being prepared now, if all goes to plan Miretti will fly on Wednesday. 🦅[Fabrizio Romano]
.@juventusfc, the transfer of #Miretti to #Besiktas on loan with an option to buy is nearing completion.[Di Marzio]
.@OfficialASRoma has entered the race for #Kessié. @juventusfc is pushing forward but exits are needed @SkySport[Di Marzio]
Frank #Kessie is getting closer to #Juventus as a free agent. Ready a contract until 2028 + option for 2029. #transfers[Nico Schira]

⏳🆙 #Miretti-#Besiktas: a white smoke is close. In these hours, the final official offer is on the way, so as to define the deal on loan with an option to buy that could become an obligation under certain conditions. #Juventus intends to completely shed the player's full annual cost in order to add that sum to the budget destined for the agreement with #Kessié, after having saved €6M from #Arthur's salary and €2M from #Perin's.[Giovanni Albanese - Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

KAMIL GRABARA IS BIANCONERO! Kamil Grabara is a new Juventus player, joining on loan from Wolfsburg until 30 June, 2027.The 27-year-old Pole arrives to reinforce the Men’s First Team’s goal, having come through the ranks at Ruch Chorzow before setting off around Europe to play for a number of clubs. He joined Liverpool in 2016, and spent time out on loan at both Aarhus and Huddersfield while on their books. In 2021 he headed to Copenhagen for a successful three-year spell, winning two league titles and a cup, before departing for Wolfsburg in 2024. In Germany, he played 63 times in the Bundesliga.Now a new chapter begins. Welcome to Juventus, Kamil![Juventus]
